description: This file declares classes and interfaces related to assertion control within the Thunder project, including a proxy for assertion units and a base assertion type with control mechanisms.

classes.name: AssertionUnitProxy
classes.description: Proxy class managing assertion units, providing singleton access, handling assertion events, and managing a handler and lock.

classes.name: BaseAssertType
classes.description: Represents a base assertion category type with embedded control mechanisms, including enabling/disabling assertions and metadata management.

classes.name: AssertionControl
classes.description: Nested class within BaseAssertType that manages assertion control state, including enabling/disabling and metadata.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of AssertionControl.

methods.name: Metadata
methods.description: Returns the metadata associated with the assertion control.
